newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Nanshan Power to pay dividend.
newsitem.headline: China Nanshan Power to pay dividend.

text.p: Shareholders of China's Shenzhen Nanshan Power Station Co Ltd have decided to issue a pre-tax cash dividend of 0.30 yuan per share based on 1996 profits, a company statement said on Tuesday.

Nanshan has not fixed an ex-dividend date or an exchange rate for the B share dividend, which will be paid in Hong Kong dollars, a company official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The statement, published in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times, gave no further details.
The power company posted net profits of 96.02 million yuan in 1996 against 50.98 million yuan in 1995 based on international accounting standards.
Trading in Nanshan's A and B shares was suspended on Monday morning and will resume on Tuesday afternoon, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said.
